description: Logical dm_customer_equipment — encoded as checker filters/joins (no physical DM table).
source: Confluence Customer Equipment / Jaroslaw Kochanski; field map v3 (material_description)
note: Cluster is also available in all conditions (same pattern as dm_customer_general). cde_type = AUSP ATINN=24 ATWRT (NOT V_EQUI.EQART).

sources.filtering: DATBI = '9999-12-31...' AND (SPRAS = 'E' OR non-E only if no E row for EQUNR) AND KUNDE IS NOT NULL
ATINN = '1' SELECT DISTINCT ATINN, ATWRT, ATZHL

joins: EQ LEFT JEST ON EQ.OBJNR = JEST.OBJNR
JEST LEFT JOIN TJ30T ON JEST.STAT = TJ30T.ESTAT
EQ LEFT JOIN INOB ON EQ.MATNR = INOB.OBJEK
INOB LEFT JOIN AT24 ON INOB.CUOBJ = LTRIM('0', AT24.OBJEK)
INOB LEFT JOIN AT30 ON INOB.CUOBJ = LTRIM('0', AT30.OBJEK)
INOB LEFT JOIN AT52 ON INOB.CUOBJ = LTRIM('0', AT52.OBJEK)
INOB LEFT JOIN AT27 ON INOB.CUOBJ = LTRIM('0', AT27.OBJEK)
AT30 LEFT JOIN CAWN_CRM ON AT30.ATWRT = CAWN_CRM.ATWRT
CAWNT_CRM ON CAWN_CRM.ATINN = CAWNT_CRM.ATINN AND CAWN_CRM.ATZHL = CAWNT_CRM.ATZHL
LEFT JOIN MAKT ON EQ.MATNR = MAKT.MATNR

field_map.cde_type: at24.ATWRT (AUSP ATINN=24 via INOB; NOT EQART)
